review_rules: Ithelia-related history is unusually vulnerable to erased or altered memory; preserve source date, speaker knowledge state and later revelations
Do not retroactively rewrite older sources merely because later ESO content introduces forgotten events or entities
Paths of possibility, fate and reality alteration require explicit evidence provenance and should not become unrestricted explanations for contradictions
Hermaeus Mora's claims about secrets and history remain attributed where not independently corroborated
Apocrypha locations, memories, books and manifestations should remain distinguishable despite overlapping names
Cross-link existing Hermaeus Mora, Apocrypha, Necrom, Telvanni, Fargrave, Black Books and Forbidden Knowledge subjects
